controles.affirmation: IBG, Inc. ne detient qu'environ 26,5% d'IBG LLC ; sur 1 338 M$ de resultat net, 1 026 M$ vont aux minoritaires et 312 M$ aux actionnaires ordinaires ; fonds propres 5 904 M$ sur 22 250 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. ... is a Delaware holding company whose primary asset is its ownership of approximately 26.5 % of the membership interests of IBG LLC" ; compte de resultat 1,338 / 1,026 / 312 ; bilan 5,904 / 16,346 / 22,250 ; income before income taxes 1,456

controles.affirmation: La part de M. Peterffy dans Holdings est passee d'environ 84,6% a l'IPO a 91,8% au 31 juillet 2026 ; Holdings detient 73,4%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 4 : "IBG, Inc.'s interest in IBG LLC has increased to approximately 26.6 %, with Holdings owning the remaining 73.4 % as of July 31, 2026. The redemptions also increased the Holdings interest held by Mr. Thomas Peterffy and his affiliates from approximately 84.6 % at the IPO to approximately 91.8 % as of July 31, 2026." Le 10-K FY2025 chiffre les droits de vote a 73,7% et la detention economique a 91,6% ; l'ATT actualise correctement avec la Note 4.

controles.affirmation: Comite des remunerations compose de Thomas Peterffy (president), Earl H. Nemser et Milan Galik, aucun independant ; "controlled company" au sens Nasdaq
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "Our Compensation Committee is comprised of Messrs. Thomas Peterffy (Chairman of the Compensation Committee), Earl H. Nemser (our Vice Chairman) and Milan Galik (our Chief Executive Officer). Mr. Peterffy's membership on the Compensation Committee may give rise to conflicts of interests..." ; "we are eligible to be and are, treated as a 'controlled company' for purposes of the Nasdaq Marketplace Rules"

controles.affirmation: Marge nette d'interet 2,36% en 2023, 2,35% en 2024, 2,08% en 2025, 1,93% au T2 2026 contre 2,07% un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net interest margin declined from 2.07% in the prior-year quarter to 1.93% in the current quarter primarily due to lower interest rates." 10-K FY2025 : "Net interest margin declined from 2.35% in the prior year to 2.08% in the current year"

controles.affirmation: Les actifs porteurs d'interets moyens ont progresse de 37% sur un an alors que le produit net d'interets n'a progresse que de 28%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Higher average balances contributed to a 23% rise in net interest income over the prior-year quarter." Le 28% provient du tableau des interets (1 100 M$ contre 861 M$), agregat different du produit net d'interets publie au compte de resultat (1 057 M$, +23%) cite deux phrases plus haut dans la meme ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : les actifs porteurs d'interets moyens progressent de 37% (228 615 M$ contre 166 621 M$) alors que le produit net d'interets publie ne progresse que de 23%. L'ecart est encore plus large que celui affiche.

controles.affirmation: Aucun litige significatif en cours ; l'action collective a ete soldee le 17 juin 2026 pour 5 M$ et environ 1,8 M$ de creances abandonnees
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The Court conducted a fairness hearing and gave final approval for the settlement on June 17, 2026, dismissing all claims with prejudice. Under the terms of the settlement agreement, the Company paid $5 million to the class and IB LLC forgave approximately $1.8 million of debts owed by certain class members" ; "As of June 30, 2026 and 2025, accruals for potential losses related to legal, regulatory and governmental actions and proceedings matters were not material." Reference de note erronee dans l'ATT : il s'agit de la Note 13 "Commitments, Contingencies, and Guarantees", pas de la Note 12.
controles.correction_proposee: Corriger la reference : Note 13 du 10-Q T2 2026 (et non Note 12).

controles.affirmation: Commission moyenne par ordre 2,64 $ au T2 2026 ; DARTs 4,82 M (+36%) ; 5,185 M de comptes (+34%) ; DARTs annualises par compte 207 contre 206
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Average commission per commissionable order for cleared customers decreased slightly to $2.64 for the current quarter compared to $2.65 for the prior-year quarter" et tableau des statistiques clients
